# hyperfluid_alert_matrix_bot (Resource)

A Matrix account the platform logs in to post alerts to Matrix or Tchap rooms, named by `hyperfluid_alert_channel` channels of kind `matrix`. The account's password and recovery key are referenced as plaintext secrets (`hyperfluid_secret`). A bot cannot be destroyed while a channel still names it. When the bot's session ends (`relogin_required`), make it log in again from the console or with `hfctl alerting matrix-bots relogin`; the provider has no action for it. Needs the organization's `alerting_enabled` feature.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The bot account's password and recovery key live in plaintext secrets; the
# bot only references them by id.
variable "tchap_bot_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "tchap_bot_recovery_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "hyperfluid_secret" "tchap_bot_password" {
  name             = "tchap-bot-password"
  secret_type      = "plaintext"
  value            = var.tchap_bot_password
  value_wo_version = "1"
}

resource "hyperfluid_secret" "tchap_bot_recovery_key" {
  name             = "tchap-bot-recovery-key"
  secret_type      = "plaintext"
  value            = var.tchap_bot_recovery_key
  value_wo_version = "1"
}

resource "hyperfluid_alert_matrix_bot" "tchap" {
  name                   = "tchap-alerts"
  preset                 = "tchap"
  user_id                = "@bot-alerts:agent.dinum.tchap.gouv.fr"
  password_secret_id     = hyperfluid_secret.tchap_bot_password.id
  recovery_key_secret_id = hyperfluid_secret.tchap_bot_recovery_key.id
}

# Any other homeserver takes the `generic` preset and its https homeserver:
#
#   preset         = "generic"
#   homeserver_url = "https://matrix.example.org"
#   user_id        = "@alerts:example.org"
#
# Set `allow_unencrypted_rooms = true` to let the bot post into a room that is
# not end-to-end encrypted. When the bot's session ends (`relogin_required`),
# make it log in again from the console or with
# `hfctl alerting matrix-bots relogin <name>`.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Bot name, shown in the console.
- `password_secret_id` (String) Id of the plaintext secret holding the bot account's password.
- `preset` (String) `tchap` (the French state messenger: the homeserver follows from `user_id`) or `generic` (any homeserver, named by `homeserver_url`).
- `recovery_key_secret_id` (String) Id of the plaintext secret holding the recovery key the account showed at setup.
- `user_id` (String) The bot account's MXID, e.g. `@bot-alerts:agent.dinum.tchap.gouv.fr`.

### Optional

- `allow_unencrypted_rooms` (Boolean) Whether the bot may post into a room that is not end-to-end encrypted. Defaults to `false`.
- `homeserver_url` (String) The homeserver (`https://…`); required with `generic`, refused with `tchap`.

### Read-Only

- `device_id` (String) The Matrix device the bot lives on, once its first login completed.
- `id` (String) Bot id, named by a channel's `matrix.bot_id`.
- `message` (String) What the phase is about; names the action when a re-login is needed.
- `phase` (String) Where the bot's notifier stands: `pending`, `connecting`, `connected`, `degraded`, `needs_login`, `disabled` or `unknown`.
- `relogin_required` (Boolean) The bot's session ended; re-login from the console or with `hfctl alerting matrix-bots relogin`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Matrix bot import id is the bot id (uuid).
terraform import hyperfluid_alert_matrix_bot.tchap 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
